_readme: THE DROSTE BOAT -- a playable scene. You are at the helm of the Novurania 18 RHIB off the
north jetty of the Merrimack on the afternoon of 2026-08-28, with the storm sea running. Over
the mouth hangs the Droste portal: the globe within the globe, this same planet at a smaller
scale, turned a quarter, with this very inlet and this very boat inside it, and inside that
one more, three levels deep. Drive into the portal and you dive: the nearest ground becomes
the next level down and the world is whole again at its new size (the log says when).
Everything drawn is the same data: the colour and the mask on the standing blocks of the
pyramid, the plane orthos and the survey read straight from their files through the scene's
`sources`, the solver waiting for its whole bed before it starts, and one water under the boat
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/droste_boat.json
HELM   W / S  both throttles ahead / astern      A / D  steer to port / starboard
Q / E  split the levers (pivot)           Shift / Ctrl  trim out / in
T      leave the helm: the camera flies free (the boat keeps its throttles); T again returns
FLY    W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look, wheel = speed
TIME   Space pause, Up / Down time x10 / /10, Left / Right nudge.   R reload shaders.
The first boot paints the plane orthos into the tree once (about half a minute) and says so.
